title: ¡Tito se disfraza de calabaza! 🎃🦷 | Canciones Infantiles #Shorts
world: cozy autumn night: porch with glowing smiling jack-o-lanterns, orange and purple fairy lights + warm bathroom-mirror corner
story: Tito pops out in a pumpkin costume put on backwards, only his trunk sticks out (funny problem)
Mamá laughs and turns the costume around; Tito shows a big grin (fix 1)
He grabs his candy bucket and runs to the door, but Mamá raises a toothbrush: first, teeth! (conflict)
Brushing in front of the mirror, bubbles, his teeth sparkle (the habit)
On the porch: glowing smiling jack-o-lanterns light up one by one (wonder)
A tiny friendly sheet ghost toy waves hello, Tito waves back and giggles (sweet, not scary)
Tito and Mamá share a candy under the orange lights (reward)
Tito tries to put the costume on his head again, backwards (loop gag)
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Uy! ¿Dónde está Tito?
[Verse]
¡Calabaza al revés!
¿Dulces? ¡Primero, los dientes!
Cepillo, cepillo, ¡qué brillo!
[Chorus]
¡Calabazas que brillan!
¡Hola, fantasmita!
¡Dulce, dulce, qué rico!
[Outro]
¡Feliz noche, Tito!
style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: TITO, a baby elephant toddler. Powder-blue body, very big round ears with peach-pink insides, short soft trunk curled up at the tip, big glossy dark-brown eyes with white sparkle highlights, rosy cheeks, a tiny tuft of three hairs on top of the head, wearing small sunny-yellow overalls with one round red button, short chubby arms and legs, small tail.
mama_lock: MAMÁ ELEFANTA, the mother of the baby elephant: a gentle grown-up adult elephant with motherly adult proportions, clearly taller and slimmer than a toddler, longer legs and a longer graceful trunk, soft lavender-grey body, big round ears with peach-pink insides, warm brown eyes with long eyelashes, a kind smile, wearing a soft lilac dress with tiny white polka dots, a white apron, and a small yellow flower behind one ear.

locations.porche: A cozy wooden house porch on an autumn evening, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level: three big glowing orange jack-o-lanterns with friendly smiling carved faces on the steps, strings of warm orange and purple fairy lights, fallen orange and yellow leaves, a soft purple evening sky with a big friendly round moon, a small wooden front door with a wreath of autumn leaves. Nobody is on the porch.
locations.espejo: A warm cozy bathroom corner in the evening, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level: a round mirror above a small white sink, a cup with a small blue toothbrush and a tube of toothpaste, a little wooden step stool, soft warm lamp light, purple and orange tiles, a tiny pumpkin decoration on the shelf. Nobody is in the bathroom.

shots: Extreme close-up from the front on the porch at night: a round orange pumpkin costume on the baby elephant worn BACKWARDS, so only the round orange back of the pumpkin is visible with the tip of a little blue trunk poking out of a small hole and wiggling, glowing jack-o-lanterns blurred behind.
The pumpkin costume wobbles and the little trunk tip wiggles out of the hole.

Medium shot, side view on the porch: Mamá Elefanta laughing turns the round pumpkin costume around on the baby elephant with both hands; now the baby elephant's happy face pops out of the round opening, wearing a round orange pumpkin costume with a short green stem on top, his face and ears sticking out of the round opening, his yellow overalls hidden.
Mamá turns the costume around and the baby elephant's face pops out grinning.

Low angle from behind the baby elephant wearing a round orange pumpkin costume with a short green stem on top, his face and ears sticking out of the round opening, his yellow overalls hidden: he runs toward the glowing front door holding a small orange candy bucket; at the door Mamá Elefanta holds up a small blue toothbrush with a smile.
He runs toward the door, then stops and looks up at the toothbrush.

Close-up from the side in front of the bathroom mirror: the baby elephant wearing a round orange pumpkin costume with a short green stem on top, his face and ears sticking out of the round opening, his yellow overalls hidden brushes his teeth with a small blue toothbrush, white foam bubbles around his mouth, his reflection smiling in the round mirror.
He brushes up and down, foam bubbles float up and his teeth sparkle.

Wide shot of the autumn porch at night: three big glowing jack-o-lanterns with friendly smiling faces light up in a row, orange and purple fairy lights, the big smiling moon, the baby elephant wearing a round orange pumpkin costume with a short green stem on top, his face and ears sticking out of the round opening, his yellow overalls hidden stands small in front of them looking up with wonder.
The jack-o-lanterns glow brighter one by one and the fairy lights twinkle.

Close-up, over-the-shoulder from behind the baby elephant in the pumpkin costume: a tiny cute white sheet ghost toy with two big round friendly eyes and a little smile floats in front of him and waves a small hand; the baby elephant waves back.
The tiny friendly ghost floats and waves, the baby elephant waves back and giggles.

Medium shot, side view on the porch steps under orange fairy lights: the baby elephant wearing a round orange pumpkin costume with a short green stem on top, his face and ears sticking out of the round opening, his yellow overalls hidden and Mamá Elefanta sit side by side and share a wrapped candy from the orange bucket, smiling at each other.
They share the candy and smile at each other, the lights twinkle.

Close-up from the front: the baby elephant playfully pulls the round orange pumpkin costume down over his head the wrong way again, only the tip of his little blue trunk poking out of a small hole, wiggling.
The costume slips down over his head and his trunk tip wiggles out again.
